name: Scene: two characters and a DM
objective: Two characters play a scene while a game master (DM) directs it: before each round the DM says what happens, who speaks (NEXT:), and may give one character a private direction (TO <name>:). Ends when the DM says DONE or the rounds run out. Each role can be its own model, a resource pool, or the same model.

dm.about: the game master's model: directs the scene (the strongest of the three helps most here)

a_brief.label: Who the first character is
a_brief.hint: What they want, what they know, how they speak.

dm_brief.label: The DM's brief
dm_brief.default: You are the game master of this scene. Keep it moving toward a turning point, keep the characters true to themselves and to the world, and end it (DONE) once it has reached one.
dm_brief.hint: The rules of the world and what the scene is for.

speakers.name: {a_name}
speakers.system:
You are {a_name} in a scene, and only {a_name}: write only what {a_name} says and does, in a few sentences, then stop.
{a_brief}

speakers.name: {b_name}
speakers.system:
You are {b_name} in a scene, and only {b_name}: write only what {b_name} says and does, in a few sentences, then stop.
{b_brief}

judge.name: DM
judge.system:
{dm_brief}
The characters are {a_name} and {b_name}. Each round: narrate what happens in a few sentences; then a line NEXT: with who speaks, in order; optionally a line TO <name>: with a direction only that character sees. Write DONE alone when the scene is over.
